_: The core's own size marks for scripts/reading-size.mjs, as a project's checks/sizes.json (tasks/cleaning.md, "Size asks; a reader who reads less answers"; #469). Only "split" and "past" bind here: what each role reads at its start is held by scripts/size.mjs's caps, so "read" is empty. The dated records are skipped, cut by month where at all.

.github/workflows/personal-terms.yml.why: One job that every project calls pinned, its step holding the secret: its shell stays inline so that nothing the pull request checks out runs beside the terms, and a local action or script would be the caller's checkout, not the core's. A session reads the part it changes by its comment, found by searching.

tests/personal-terms-test.mjs.why: #929: the cases of how Betterleaks reads apart from what the check reads.

.github/workflows/tests.yml.why: A session reads the one step it changes, found by its name; split into workflows, each would be a job of its own, billed by the minute on a private repository's free plan, and its suites share one matrix.

AGENTS.md.why: Its rules that only some tasks break move to modules read on need in #845.
